title: Backend REST API Service
description: Step-by-step guidance for building, testing, securing, and deploying a production-ready REST API service.

steps.title: API Scope & Resource Definition
steps.goal: Identify resources, consumers, and data requirements for the backend service.
steps.expectedOutput: List of core resources/entities and expected API consumer types.
steps.prompt:
I am building a backend REST API called "{{project.name}}".
The goal is: {{project.idea}}.
My experience level is {{project.experienceLevel}}.

Act as a Senior Backend Architect:
1. Identify the core resources/entities (e.g. users, items, transactions).
2. Define the consumer profiles (e.g. mobile app, single page web app, 3rd party webhooks).
3. List non-negotiable MVP capabilities for V1.

steps.title: Runtime, Framework & Database Selection
steps.goal: Select a performant backend framework, database engine, and ORM/query builder.
steps.expectedOutput: Chosen runtime (Node.js/Go/Python), web framework (Express/Fastify/NestJS), database, and ORM.
steps.prompt:
For "{{project.name}}" handling {{decisions.coreResources}}, recommend the optimal backend stack for a {{project.experienceLevel}} developer:
1. Runtime and Framework (e.g. Node.js with Fastify or Express).
2. Database (e.g. PostgreSQL with Prisma/Drizzle or SQLite for prototyping).
3. Validation library (e.g. Zod or Joi).
4. Justification for why this stack provides simplicity and safety.

steps.title: Database Schema & Relationships
steps.goal: Define relational/document schema, field types, constraints, and indexes.
steps.expectedOutput: Database schema definitions (SQL DDL / ORM models), indexes, and relations.
steps.prompt:
Design the database schema for "{{project.name}}" using {{decisions.database}}:
1. Schema definition for {{decisions.coreResources}}.
2. Indexes on frequently queried and foreign key columns.
3. Seed data script with sample records for local testing.

steps.title: REST Endpoints & OpenAPI Specification
steps.goal: Define standard HTTP verbs, URL routes, status codes, query parameters, and error envelopes.
steps.expectedOutput: Endpoint routing table and JSON request/response schema specifications.
steps.prompt:
Create the complete API endpoint specification for "{{project.name}}":
1. Endpoints table (Method, Path, Auth Required, Query Params, Request Body, Response 200/201/400/404/500).
2. Standard unified error response contract `{ error: { code: string, message: string, details?: any } }`.
3. Pagination convention for collection routes (e.g. limit/offset or cursor-based).

steps.title: Project Scaffolding & Configuration
steps.goal: Initialize project repository, install dependencies, set up environment variables and linting.
steps.expectedOutput: Step-by-step CLI commands, package.json scripts, and .env.example file.
steps.prompt:
Provide terminal commands and configuration to scaffold "{{project.name}}" using {{decisions.runtime}}, {{decisions.framework}}, and {{decisions.database}}:
1. Project initialization and dependencies installation.
2. `.env.example` file.
3. Entrypoint server script (`server.js` or `src/index.ts`).
4. Database connection file.

steps.title: Authentication & Authorization Middleware
steps.goal: Implement JWT verification, API key authentication, or session middleware with role-based access control.
steps.expectedOutput: Auth routes (`/auth/register`, `/auth/login`), JWT signing/verification, and guard middleware.
steps.prompt:
Implement authentication and access control for "{{project.name}}":
1. User registration with password hashing (bcrypt/argon2).
2. User login endpoint issuing signed JWTs.
3. Reusable authentication guard middleware to protect private routes.
4. Role or permission checking helper.

steps.title: CRUD Controllers & Service Layer
steps.goal: Implement business logic, request validation, and database queries for each endpoint.
steps.expectedOutput: Controller and service files with input validation and clean error handling.
steps.prompt:
Implement the controllers and service layer for "{{project.name}}":
1. Route handlers matching {{decisions.endpointList}}.
2. Zod/Joi schema validation on incoming request bodies and query params.
3. Service layer functions executing database queries.
4. Proper HTTP response codes and consistent error formatting.

steps.title: Integration Testing with Supertest / Vitest
steps.goal: Write comprehensive automated API tests verifying status codes, headers, and payloads.
steps.expectedOutput: Integration test files testing successful and erroneous scenarios.
steps.prompt:
Write automated integration tests for "{{project.name}}" API routes:
1. Test setup with in-memory database or test database container.
2. Integration test cases for Auth (signup, login, unauthorized access).
3. CRUD tests for {{decisions.coreResources}} (happy path and validation errors).
4. Test runner command in package.json.

steps.title: Rate Limiting, CORS & Security Headers
steps.goal: Protect API against brute force attacks, denial of service, and cross-origin leaks.
steps.expectedOutput: Rate limiter configuration, CORS whitelist, Helmet security headers, and request size limits.
steps.prompt:
Harden the security of "{{project.name}}":
1. Rate limiting configuration (e.g. express-rate-limit) for public and auth endpoints.
2. Strict CORS headers allowing only configured origins.
3. Security headers (Helmet) and body payload size limits.
4. Input sanitization to prevent injection attacks.

steps.title: Production Deployment & Health Monitoring
steps.goal: Deploy the API to cloud hosting, configure automated health checks, and expose OpenAPI docs.
steps.expectedOutput: Deployment configuration (Dockerfile / PaaS config), health check route `/health`, and API documentation setup.
steps.prompt:
Deploy "{{project.name}}" to production:
1. Recommended hosting platform (e.g. Render, Railway, Fly.io).
2. Dockerfile or cloud configuration manifest.
3. `/health` check endpoint for uptime monitoring.
4. Instructions for connecting remote managed database and setting production environment variables.
